footnotes: (1) The dates of payment given for the service of the Pienlo, Honan and Shansi Railway Loans are those of payment in Europe, but exchange in connection with the service of the loans in question may be fixed in China at any time by the companies concerned.
(2) The actual dates of repayment of the instalments of the $96,000,000 Loan (Japanese Share) synchronize really with the dates of monthly salt releases.

(3) This loan is repayable in monthly quotas of £10,000 and of $50,000 at the end of each month until extinguishment with accrued interest commencing from July 1922. Extension of 9 months was allowed, and repayment should have been completed as to silver portion by July 1926 and as to Sterling portion by May 1927. Amount outstanding including interest on December 31, 1926, was £393,845-6-6 and $1,192,834.21.
(4) These loans though falling due in 1928 are payable in 1927, and are, therefore, included in this list.
Note:—Only known defaults up to August 31, 1927 are noted in above table. It may be assumed that the loans in default on that date will continue to default until the end of the year.
